content:
**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Single curved/crescent-shaped young mango leaf/shoot on white background
- Yellowish-green base color with scattered irregular brown necrotic patches
- Curled/crumpled form, not uniformly dead throughout

**Key comparisons from reference images:**

| Class | Match assessment |
|---|---|
| **Anthracnose** | Bottom panels show curled young leaves with brown necrotic patches on white bg — strong match to shape and coloration |
| **Die_Back** | Leaves are uniformly dark brown, tightly curled/dried — too brown/dead, less patchy |
| **Cutting_Weevil** | Shows bare stripped shoots with almost no leaf tissue — does not match |
| **Gall_Midge** | Green leaves with raised blister galls — no match |
| **Bacterial_Canker** | Angular necrotic margins on mature leaves — no match |
| **Sooty_Mould** | Black coating on green leaves — no match |

The test image shows a young mango leaf in mid-disease progression: still partly green-yellow with irregular brown necrotic lesions, curled and crumpled. This matches Anthracnose's description of "semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves" and the reference images showing curled young leaves with brown necrosis — not the uniformly dead/brown curled form seen in Die_Back.
